scope: Core KIMI model integration and provider calls — client/sdk, endpoint config, model invocation logic, request/response shapes, streaming vs sync.

summary.client_type: Thin async provider class (Kimi) wrapping the OpenAI SDK (openai.AsyncOpenAI v2.14); kimi_sdk is a thin re-export layer over kosong
summary.model_config: Models are not hard-coded; discovered dynamically at runtime via GET /v1/models. Default model: kimi-k2-turbo-preview. Env-driven overrides: KIMI_MODEL_NAME, KIMI_BASE_URL, KIMI_API_KEY
summary.transport_mechanism: httpx.AsyncClient (managed internally by AsyncOpenAI, HTTP/1.1 default). Sync path uses with_raw_response.create; streaming path uses create(stream=True, stream_options={include_usage: True}) returning AsyncStream[ChatCompletionChunk] SSE

runtime.httpx: 0.28.1 (kimi-cli root uses httpx[socks]==0.28.1; kimi-sdk bound: httpx>=0.28.1,<0.29.0)

kosong.role: LLM abstraction layer: ChatProvider protocol, Kimi provider, message/tooling types, generate/step orchestration

kimi_sdk.role: Thin re-export facade: imports generate, step, Kimi, Message, Tool, etc. from kosong; no own transport logic

kimi_cli.role: CLI application; constructs Kimi provider via create_llm() in llm.py; manages OAuth, config, runtime/session lifecycle

construction.api_key_resolution: api_key arg > KIMI_API_KEY env var (required; raises ChatProviderError if unset)
construction.base_url_resolution: base_url arg > KIMI_BASE_URL env var > default https://api.moonshot.ai/v1
construction.client_kwargs: forwarded to openai.AsyncOpenAI (e.g. http_client, timeout, default_headers, max_retries)

http_transport.http2: not explicitly set (defaults to False in OpenAI SDK; httpx default)
http_transport.injectable: Yes via client_kwargs['http_client'] (used in tests with httpx.MockTransport)

model_list.discovery: Dynamic via GET {base_url}/models — returns list of ModelInfo (id, context_length, supports_reasoning, supports_image_in, supports_video_in, display_name). Filtered by platform.allowed_prefixes when set.

capability_derivation.thinking: enabled if supports_reasoning=true OR model name contains 'thinking'/'reason' OR model id starts with 'kimi-k2'
capability_derivation.image_in: if supports_image_in=true OR model starts with 'kimi-k2' OR model is 'kimi-for-coding'/'kimi-code'

top_level_fields.tools: list (OpenAI format; see tool conversion below)
top_level_fields.max_completion_tokens: integer|null (canonical key; 'max_tokens' is deprecated alias normalized to this)
top_level_fields.max_tokens: DEPRECATED alias — normalized to max_completion_tokens before sending; omitted when None
top_level_fields.reasoning_effort: string|null (legacy passthrough — NOT sent when with_thinking is used)

tool_shape.builtin_detection: Tool names starting with '$' are serialized as builtin_function

response_shape.streaming: AsyncStream[ChatCompletionChunk] (SSE); usage returned in final chunk when stream_options.include_usage=True
response_shape.trace_header: x-trace-id (response header, captured from both sync and streaming paths)

extra_body_thinking.merge_semantics: with_extra_body deep-merges the 'thinking' sub-dict (field-by-field); all other extra_body keys use last-writer-wins shallow merge

tool_conversion_quirks.moonshot_schema_type_requirement: Moonshot API rejects tool parameter schemas where a nested property omits 'type' (HTTP 400: 'type is not defined'). This is stricter than OpenAI/Anthropic which accept type-less properties.
tool_conversion_quirks.ensure_property_types: kosong.utils.jsonschema.ensure_property_types() walks properties/items/additionalProperties/anyOf/oneOf/allOf and fills missing 'type' (inferred from enum/const values or structural keywords; defaults to 'string')
tool_conversion_quirks.assistant_content_empty_with_tool_calls: When assistant has tool_calls and effectively-empty text content, the Kimi provider omits the 'content' field entirely (Kimi-compat layer rejects content:[{type:text,text:""}])
tool_conversion_quirks.reasoning_content_round_trip: ThinkPart content serialized as 'reasoning_content' on assistant messages; empty-string delta means 'reasoned but empty' (NOT 'no reasoning') and must surface as ThinkPart to preserve thinking round-trip for the server

stream_true_default.usage: In final chunk when include_usage=True; also via extract_usage_from_chunk fallback scanning choices[0].usage

abstraction_layer.behavior: Constructor accepts either ChatCompletion (sync) or AsyncStream[ChatCompletionChunk] (streaming); sets _iter to _convert_non_stream_response or _convert_stream_response; both yield StreamedMessagePart (TextPart, ThinkPart, ToolCall, ToolCallPart) as async iterator
abstraction_layer.usage_property: TokenUsage with cached_tokens translation: input_other = prompt_tokens - cached_tokens; input_cache_read = cached_tokens

sdk_orchestration.kosong.generate: Calls chat_provider.generate(), iterates stream parts, merges via merge_in_place into a single Message. Raises APIEmptyResponseError on empty or think-only responses. Accepts on_message_part/on_tool_call/on_trace_id callbacks.
sdk_orchestration.kosong.step: Layers tool dispatch over generate(); returns StepResult with awaited tool outputs; cancels pending futures on ChatProviderError/CancelledError

error_handling.conversion: convert_error() in openai_common.py maps OpenAIError + httpx.HTTPError to kosong error hierarchy. APIStatusError carries status_code, request_id (x-request-id), trace_id (x-trace-id). Base APIError without body classified heuristically via regex (timeout/network patterns).
error_handling.retryable_recovery: on_retryable_error() in Kimi rebuilds the AsyncOpenAI client from self._api_key (or client.api_key), preserving OAuth-refreshed tokens; closes old client via close_replaced_openai_client (guards against closing shared httpx.AsyncClient when caller injected http_client)

cli_integration.llm_create_factory: create_llm(provider, model, thinking, session_id, oauth) in src/kimi_cli/llm.py constructs Kimi with default_headers from oauth.common_headers + provider.custom_headers; applies generation_kwargs from KIMI_MODEL_* env vars (temperature, top_p, max_completion_tokens)
cli_integration.thinking_config: with_thinking('high') applied when model is always_thinking OR (thinking=True and model supports thinking). KIMI_MODEL_THINKING_KEEP env injects extra_body.thinking.keep only when thinking is enabled
cli_integration.prompt_cache_key: session_id passed as prompt_cache_key for request-level caching

pydantic_v2_api_client_proposal.rationale: ai-factory uses Pydantic v2 + Pydantic-AI. A typed client built on pydantic.BaseModel models + httpx.AsyncClient gives fail-fast validation, clean serialization via model_dump(), and zero OpenAI-SDK coupling for the factory's own provider integrations.

design.base_classes: pydantic.BaseModel with model_config = ConfigDict(populate_by_name=True, extra='forbid', alias_generator=to_camel)
design.serialization: Use model_dump(by_alias=True, exclude_none=True) for wire serialization; model_validate() for response parsing
design.transport: Single httpx.AsyncClient instance with connection pooling; HTTP/1.1 explicit (http2=False) to match ai-factory's LiteRouter proxy convention
design.auth: Bearer token from KIMI_API_KEY env or injected SecretStr; re-read from live client to support OAuth refresh (mirrors kimi-cli on_retryable_error pattern)
design.stream_parsing: Parse SSE event lines; accumulate tool_call deltas by index; yield typed ChatCompletionChunk model; extract x-trace-id from response headers before streaming begins
design.error_mapping: httpx.HTTPStatusError -> typed exception with status_code, trace_id from x-trace-id header; httpx.TimeoutException -> timeout error; match kimi-cli's convert_error classification (timeout regex first, then network)
design.token_usage_translation: cached_tokens from prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens -> input_cache_read; prompt_tokens - cached -> input_other; completion_tokens -> output — mirror kosong.TokenUsage mapping

model_proposal.name: KimiRequest
validators: _normalize_max_tokens_alias: max_tokens -> max_completion_tokens; omit None values for max_* keys

model_proposal.name: KimiExtraBody
model_proposal.note: Deep-merge for thinking sub-keys; shallow merge for top-level extras (mirrors with_extra_body semantics)

model_proposal.name: KimiThinkingConfig
model_proposal.note: Moonshot-specific preserved-thinking switch; keep forwarded verbatim

model_proposal.name: KimiChatCompletion
model_proposal.note: Supports Moonshot additions: reasoning_content on assistant message, cached_tokens in usage

model_proposal.name: KimiStreamedMessagePart (Union)
members: ThinkPart {type: 'think', think: str, encrypted: str | None}
ToolCallDelta {index: int, id: str | None, name: str | None, arguments: str | None}
UsageDelta {prompt_tokens: int, completion_tokens: int, cached_tokens: int | None}
model_proposal.note: Mirrors kosong StreamedMessagePart; supports incremental merging of tool_call deltas by index

model_proposal.name: KimiModelInfo
computed: capabilities: set[ModelCapability] derived from fields + name heuristics

pydantic_v2_api_client_proposal.usage_example:
async with KimiApiClient(base_url='https://api.moonshot.ai/v1', api_key=SecretStr(os.getenv('KIMI_API_KEY'))) as client:
    # sync
    resp = await client.chat(KimiRequest(model='kimi-k2-turbo-preview', messages=[...], max_completion_tokens=2048))
    # stream
    async for part in client.chat_stream(KimiRequest(..., stream=True)):
        ...
    # models
    models = await client.list_models()
